scripts.native:build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.native:build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.native:assets: node scripts/render-resources.mjs && npx --yes @capacitor/assets@3.0.5 generate --ios --android --assetPath resources --iconBackgroundColor '#17171c' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#17171c' --splashBackgroundColor '#ffffff' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#17171c' && bash scripts/sharpen-adaptive-icons.sh
